d:
Investing has never been easier. However, research indicates that effortless, on-tap investing on mobile apps also makes it easier to lose money.
How many times have you checked your stock portfolio today? Once? Five times? Ten times?
And when you see a stock rising or falling, do you feel the urge to do something — buy more, sell, or perhaps find another stock to invest in?
Apps have democratised access to financial markets. But recent reports suggest that the same convenience can encourage us to trade more frequently, take greater risks, and sometimes lose more money.
